metadata.target_conclusion: 40-50 hostages are being held at cafe in Sydney (according to Lindt CEO)

attack_plan.narrative: Update: Five hostages escape as a gunman continues siege in Sydney cafe. Since the siege began yesterday, five additional hostages have joined the group, bringing the total number to around 40-50. The Lindt CEO has reported that the situation is critical and urgent. Reports indicate that the gunman is demanding an ISIS flag, though this has not been verified. The Grand Mufti of Australia has condemned the incident, emphasizing that it is not reflective of the true values of Islam. Law enforcement has been working tirelessly to resolve the situation peacefully, and the community has rallied around the hostages, with many offering support through the #illridewithyou hashtag.
